meta.source: LODR Compliance Calendar and Material Events.xlsx

events.event: Acquisition(s) (including agreement to acquire); Scheme of Arrangement (amalgamation, merger, demerger or restructuring); sale or disposal of any unit(s), division(s), whole or substantially the whole of the undertaking(s) or subsidiary of the listed entity; sale of stake in an associate company; or any other restructuring.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: 30 min from close of board meeting (or 3 hrs if it closed after trading hours and >3 hrs before next day's open) / Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Expl.1 - 'acquisition' means (i) acquiring control, direct or indirect; OR (ii) acquiring / agreeing to acquire shares or voting rights such that (a) the LE holds >=20% of shares/VR; or (b) change from last disclosure exceeds 5%; or (c) cost of acquisition exceeds the Reg 30(4)(i)(c) threshold. PROVISO: acquisition of >=5% in an UNLISTED company, and any change >2% since last disclosure, is disclosed QUARTERLY in the specified format. Expl.2 - covers agreements to sell such that a company ceases to be a WOS/subsidiary/associate, or where the sale exceeds the Reg 30(4)(i)(c) threshold. Expl.3 - 'undertaking' / 'substantially the whole of the undertaking' per s.180 Companies Act 2013.

events.event: Issuance or forfeiture of securities; split or consolidation of shares; buyback of securities; any restriction on transferability of securities; or alteration in terms or structure of existing securities including forfeiture, reissue of forfeited securities, alteration of calls, redemption of securities etc.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: 30 min from close of board meeting (or 3 hrs if it closed after trading hours and >3 hrs before next day's open) / Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: New Rating(s) or Revision in Rating(s).
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity (rating action originates outside the LE)
events.notes: 'New Rating(s) or' inserted - a first-time rating is now itself a disclosable event, not just a revision.

events.event: OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETINGS held to consider: (a) dividends recommended/declared or decision to pass any dividend + date of payment/dispatch; (b) cancellation of dividend with reasons; (c) decision on buyback; (d) decision on fund raising - by issue of securities (excluding security receipts, securitised debt instruments or RBI-regulated money market instruments) through FPO, rights issue, ADR/GDR/FCCB, QIP, debt issue, preferential issue or any other method; (e) increase in capital by bonus issue through capitalisation + credit/dispatch date; (f) reissue of forfeited shares/securities, issue of shares/securities held in reserve, or creation of new shares/securities or rights/privileges/benefits to subscribe; (g) short particulars of any other alterations of capital, including calls; (h) financial results; (i) decision on voluntary delisting from stock exchange(s).
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: 30 min from close of board meeting (or 3 hrs if it closed after trading hours and >3 hrs before next day's open)
events.notes: For multi-day board meetings, financial results are disclosed within 30 min / 3 hrs from close of the session on the day they were considered.

events.event: Agreements - shareholder agreement(s), joint venture agreement(s), family settlement agreement(s) (to the extent they impact management and control of the LE), agreement(s)/treaty(ies)/contract(s) with media companies - which are BINDING and NOT in the normal course of business; and revision(s), amendment(s) and termination(s) thereof.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Agreements entered into by shareholders, promoters, promoter group entities, related parties, directors, KMP or employees of the LE or of its holding / subsidiary / associate company - among themselves, or with the LE, or with a third party, solely or jointly - which directly, indirectly or potentially (or whose purpose and effect is to) impact the management or control of the LE, or impose any restriction or create any liability upon the LE. Includes any rescission, amendment or alteration, WHETHER OR NOT THE LISTED ENTITY IS A PARTY.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity (or within 12 hrs where the LE is a party)
events.notes: PROVISO: normal-course agreements are exempt UNLESS they impact management/control or are otherwise disclosable. Expl.: 'directly or indirectly' includes agreements obliging parties to ensure the LE shall or shall not act in a particular manner. NOTE: Reg 30A + Sch III Part A Para A(5A) require parties to inform the LE within 2 working days.

events.event: FRAUD OR DEFAULTS by the listed entity, its promoter, director, KMP, senior management or subsidiary; OR arrest of KMP, senior management, promoter or director of the LE - whether occurring within India or abroad.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity (or 12 hrs if emanating from within the LE)
events.notes: 'Fraud' includes fraud as defined in Reg 2(1)(c) SEBI (PFUTP) Regulations, 2003. 'Default' = non-payment of interest or principal in full on the due date. Expl.1 - for revolving facilities (e.g. cash credit), default arises if the outstanding continuously exceeds the sanctioned limit or drawing power (whichever lower) for more than 30 days. Expl.2 - default by promoter/director/KMP/SM/subsidiary means default which has or may have an impact on the LE. Expl.3 - fraud by senior management (other than a promoter/director/KMP) is disclosable only if in relation to the LE.

events.event: Change in directors, KMP (Managing Director, CEO, CFO, Company Secretary etc.), SENIOR MANAGEMENT, Auditor and Compliance Officer.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: 'senior management' inserted by 2nd Amdt 2023 w.e.f. 14.07.2023.

events.event: Resignation of the AUDITOR - detailed reasons for resignation as given by the said auditor.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours of receipt of such reasons from the auditor
events.notes: Read with the SEBI circular on auditor resignations (conditions for resignation mid-year / post-limited review).

events.event: Resignation of an INDEPENDENT DIRECTOR - (i) the letter of resignation along with detailed reasons as given by the director; (ia) names of listed entities where the resigning director holds directorships, with category of directorship and committee memberships; (ii) confirmation from the ID that there is no other material reason other than those provided; (iii) that confirmation to be disclosed by the LE along with (i) and (ii).
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 7 days from the date of resignation
events.notes: Item (ia) inserted by 3rd Amdt 2024 w.e.f. 13.12.2024.

events.event: Resignation of KMP, senior management, Compliance Officer, or a director OTHER THAN an independent director - the letter of resignation along with detailed reasons as given by such person.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 7 days from the date the resignation comes into effect
events.notes: Note the different trigger: 7B runs from the DATE OF RESIGNATION; 7C runs from the date resignation COMES INTO EFFECT.

events.event: Where the Managing Director or CEO was indisposed or unavailable to fulfil the requirements of the role in a regular manner for more than 45 days in any rolling period of 90 days - the fact, along with reasons for such indisposition or unavailability.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Inserted by 2nd Amdt 2023 w.e.f. 14.07.2023. Requires an actual tracking mechanism - a rolling 90-day window.

events.event: Appointment or discontinuation of the Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent (RTA).
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Nomenclature substituted by 6th Amdt 2025 w.e.f. 16.12.2025.

events.event: RESOLUTION PLAN / RESTRUCTURING in relation to loans/borrowings from banks/financial institutions, including: (i) decision to initiate resolution of loans/borrowings; (ii) signing of Inter-Creditors Agreement (ICA) by lenders; (iii) finalisation of the Resolution Plan; (iv) implementation of the Resolution Plan; (v) salient features (not involving commercial secrets) of the resolution/restructuring plan as decided by lenders.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity

events.event: One-time settlement with a bank.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity

events.event: Winding-up petition filed by any party / creditors.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity

events.event: Issuance of notices, call letters, resolutions and circulars sent to shareholders, debenture holders or creditors or any class of them, or advertised in the media by the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Proceedings of Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings of the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Distinct from Reg 44(3) voting results (2 working days).

events.event: Amendments to the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the listed entity, in brief.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Schedule of analysts' or institutional investors' meet.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: At least 2 working days in advance (excluding the date of intimation and the date of the meet)
events.notes: Expl.I - 'meet' = group meetings or group conference calls, physical or digital. Expl.II - disclosure of NAMES in the schedule is OPTIONAL. Also required on the website: Reg 46(2)(o)(i).

events.event: Presentations prepared by the listed entity for analysts' or institutional investors' meets, post-earnings or quarterly calls.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Prior to the beginning of such events
events.notes: Also on the website: Reg 46(2)(o)(ii).

events.event: AUDIO RECORDINGS of post-earnings / quarterly calls (physical or digital).
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Promptly, and in any case before the next trading day OR within 24 hours from conclusion of the call, whichever is EARLIER
events.notes: Host on website for a minimum of 2 years, thereafter per the Reg 9(b) preservation policy.

events.event: VIDEO RECORDINGS (if any) of post-earnings / quarterly calls.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 48 hours from conclusion of the call
events.notes: Host on website for a minimum of 2 years.

events.event: TRANSCRIPTS of post-earnings / quarterly calls.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 5 working days of conclusion of the call - on the website WITH simultaneous submission to the stock exchange(s)
events.notes: Host on website for a minimum of 5 years.

events.event: CORPORATE INSOLVENCY RESOLUTION PROCESS (CIRP) of a listed corporate debtor under the Insolvency Code: (a) filing of application by the corporate applicant, specifying the amount of default; (b) filing of application by financial creditors, specifying the amount of default; (c) admission of the application by the Tribunal with the amount of default, or rejection / withdrawal; (d) public announcement pursuant to the Tribunal's order u/s 13 IBC; (e) list of creditors displayed under Reg 13(2)(c) IBBI (CIRP) Regulations, 2016; (f) appointment / replacement of the Resolution Professional; (g) prior or post-facto intimation of CoC meetings; (h) brief particulars of invitation of resolution plans u/s 25(2)(h) IBC in the Form under Reg 36A(5) IBBI (CIRP) Regulations; (i) number of resolution plans received by the RP; (j) filing of the resolution plan with the Tribunal; (k) approval of the resolution plan by the Tribunal, or rejection; (l) specific features and details of the approved resolution plan (not involving commercial secrets) - pre/post net worth; assets post CIRP; securities continuing to be imposed on assets; other material liabilities; detailed pre/post shareholding pattern assuming 100% conversion of convertibles; funds infused and creditors paid off; additional liability on incoming investors and source of funding; impact on the investor (revised P/E, RONW); names of new promoters and KMP with past experience (and, where promoters are companies, their history and natural persons in control); brief description of business strategy; (m) any other material information not involving commercial secrets; (n) proposed steps by the incoming investor/acquirer for achieving MPS; (o) QUARTERLY disclosure of status of achieving MPS; (p) details of delisting plans, if any, approved in the resolution plan.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity (or 12 hrs where the event emanates from within the LE); item (o) is QUARTERLY

events.event: INITIATION OF FORENSIC AUDIT (by whatever name called): (a) the fact of initiation, along with the name of the entity initiating the audit and reasons, if available; (b) the final forensic audit report (other than for audits initiated by regulatory / enforcement agencies), on receipt by the LE, along with management comments, if any.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity
events.notes: Expl. - 'forensic audit' means audits initiated with the objective of detecting mis-statement in financial statements, mis-appropriation, siphoning or diversion of funds. It EXCLUDES audits of product quality control, manufacturing practices, recruitment practices, supply chain / procurement, or similar matters that would not require revision of the financial statements.

events.event: Announcement or communication through SOCIAL MEDIA INTERMEDIARIES or MAINSTREAM MEDIA by directors, promoters, KMP or senior management of the LE, in relation to any event or information which is material for the LE under Reg 30 and is not already available in the public domain.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity
events.notes: Expl. - 'social media intermediaries' per the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021. This is the clause that catches a promoter's LinkedIn/X post before the LE has filed.

events.event: Action(s) INITIATED or ORDERS PASSED by any regulatory, statutory, enforcement authority or judicial body against the LE, or its directors, KMP, senior management, promoter or subsidiary (in relation to the LE), in respect of: (a) search or seizure; (b) re-opening of accounts u/s 130 Companies Act 2013; (c) investigation under Chapter XIV Companies Act 2013. To be disclosed with: (i) name of the authority; (ii) nature and details of the action/order; (iii) date of receipt of the direction/order, including any ad-interim or interim order or other communication; (iv) details of the violation(s)/contravention(s) committed or alleged; (v) impact on financial, operational or other activities, quantified in monetary terms to the extent possible.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity

events.event: Action(s) TAKEN or ORDERS PASSED by any regulatory, statutory, enforcement authority or judicial body against the LE, or its directors, KMP, senior management, promoter or subsidiary (in relation to the LE), in respect of: (a) suspension; (b) imposition of fine or penalty; (c) settlement of proceedings; (d) debarment; (e) disqualification; (f) closure of operations; (g) sanctions imposed; (h) warning or caution; or (i) any other similar action by whatever name called. Same five details as item 19 apply.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 HOURS where fine/penalty crosses the threshold; QUARTERLY (specified format) where below the threshold. Other actions: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity
events.notes: Expl. - fine or penalty of Rs.1 LAKH or more imposed by a SECTORAL REGULATOR or ENFORCEMENT AGENCY, and Rs.10 LAKH or more imposed by any OTHER authority or judicial body, must be disclosed within 24 HOURS. Fines/penalties BELOW these thresholds are disclosed on a QUARTERLY basis in the specified format.

events.event: Voluntary revision of financial statements or of the report of the board of directors of the listed entity u/s 131 Companies Act, 2013.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Commencement or any postponement in the date of commencement of commercial production or commercial operations of any unit/division.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Apply the Reg 30(4)(i) test: (a) omission would likely result in discontinuity or alteration of already-public information; (b) omission would likely result in significant market reaction if disclosed later; (c) QUANTITATIVE test - LOWER of: 2% of turnover; 2% of net worth (except where net worth is negative); or 5% of the average absolute PAT of the last 3 audited consolidated FS; (d) residual - board's opinion.

events.event: Any of the following: (a) arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing or marketing tie-up; (b) adoption of new line(s) of business; (c) closure of operation of any unit, division or subsidiary (in entirety or in piecemeal).
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Substituted by 2nd Amdt 2023 w.e.f. 14.07.2023.

events.event: Capacity addition or product launch.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Awarding, bagging / receiving, amendment or termination of awarded / bagged orders or contracts NOT in the normal course of business.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: 'Not in the normal course of business' is the gate. Order-win announcements are a common over-disclosure / under-disclosure flashpoint.

events.event: Agreements (viz. loan agreement(s) or any other agreement(s) which are BINDING and NOT in the normal course of business) and revision(s), amendment(s) or termination(s) thereof.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Disruption of operations of any one or more units or divisions of the LE due to natural calamity (earthquake, flood, fire etc.), force majeure, or events such as strikes, lockouts etc.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Effect(s) arising out of change in the regulatory framework applicable to the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Pendency of any litigation(s) or dispute(s), or the outcome thereof, which may have an impact on the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity
events.notes: Substituted by 2nd Amdt 2023 w.e.f. 14.07.2023 - note it now covers PENDENCY, not just the outcome.

events.event: Frauds or defaults by EMPLOYEES of the listed entity which has or may have an impact on the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Contrast with Para A item 6 - fraud/default by promoter/director/KMP/SM/subsidiary is DEEMED material; by employees it is subject to the materiality test.

events.event: Options to purchase securities, including any ESOP / ESPS Scheme.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Giving of guarantees or indemnity, or becoming a surety (by whatever name called) for any third party.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity

events.event: Granting, withdrawal, surrender, cancellation or suspension of key licences or regulatory approvals.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity / Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity (depending on whether the event emanates from within the LE)

events.event: Delay or default in the payment of fines, penalties, dues etc. to any regulatory, statutory, enforcement or judicial authority.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity
events.notes: Inserted by 2nd Amdt 2023 w.e.f. 14.07.2023.

events.event: ANY OTHER INFORMATION / EVENT viz. major development that is likely to affect business - e.g. emergence of new technologies, expiry of patents, any change of accounting policy that may have a significant impact on the accounts - and brief details thereof; AND any other information exclusively known to the LE which may be necessary to enable holders of its securities to appraise its position and to avoid the establishment of a FALSE MARKET in such securities.
events.materialityTest: MATERIAL only on application of Reg 30(4) guidelines
events.disclosureTimelineText: Within 12 hours - event emanating from WITHIN the listed entity / Within 24 hours - event NOT emanating from within the listed entity as applicable
events.notes: The residual catch-all. This is the clause SEBI relies on in enforcement when nothing else fits.

events.event: Without prejudice to the generality of Paras A, B and C, the listed entity MAY make disclosures of event/information as specified by SEBI from time to time.
events.materialityTest: DEEMED MATERIAL - no application of materiality guidelines
events.notes: The hook for SEBI's Industry Standards Note / disclosure circulars.

events.event: Expected default in the timely payment of interest, dividend or redemption payment (or both) in respect of non-convertible securities; and default in the creation of security for non-convertible debt securities.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive / bearing on performance
events.disclosureTimelineText: AS SOON AS THE SAME BECOMES APPARENT (and in any case within 24 hours)
events.notes: Reg 51(1) Expl. - 'promptly inform' means as soon as reasonably possible but NOT LATER THAN 24 HOURS from the date of occurrence of the event or receipt of information.

events.event: Any attachment or prohibitory orders restraining the LE from transferring non-convertible securities from the account of registered holders - with particulars of the numbers of securities affected, names of registered holders and their demat account details.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any action which shall result in the redemption, reduction, cancellation or retirement, in whole or in part, of any non-convertible securities.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any action that shall adversely affect payment of interest on NCDs or payment of dividend on NCRPS - including default by the issuer to pay interest or the redemption amount, and failure to create a charge on the assets.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any change in the form or nature of any of its non-convertible securities listed on the stock exchange(s), or in the rights or privileges of the holders thereof; and application for listing of the securities as changed, if the stock exchange(s) so require.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any changes in the general character or nature of business / activities; disruption of operation due to natural calamity; and commencement of commercial production / commercial operations.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any events such as strikes and lock-outs which have a bearing on interest payment / dividend payment / principal repayment capacity.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Details of any letter or comments made by DEBENTURE TRUSTEES regarding payment/non-payment of interest on due dates, payment/non-payment of principal on due dates, or any other matter concerning the security, the LE and/or the assets - along with the LE's comments thereon, if any.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Delay or default in payment of interest / dividend / principal amount / redemption for a period of MORE THAN THREE MONTHS from the due date.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Failure to create charge on the assets within the stipulated time period.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any instance(s) of default/delay in timely repayment of interest or principal obligations (or both) in respect of debt securities, including any proposal for re-scheduling or postponement of the repayment programmes of the dues/debts with any investor(s)/lender(s).
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any major change in the composition of its board of directors which may amount to CHANGE IN CONTROL as defined in the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any revision in the rating.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Approvals by the board of directors in their meeting: (a) the decision to pass any interest payment; (b) short particulars of any increase of capital, whether by issue of bonus securities through capitalisation, or by way of rights securities offered to the debt security holders, or in any other way.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: All information, reports, notices, call letters, circulars, proceedings etc. concerning non-convertible debt securities.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETINGS held to consider: (a) the decision with respect to fund raising proposed to be undertaken by way of non-convertible securities; (b) financial results.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive
events.disclosureTimelineText: WITHIN 30 MINUTES of the closure of the meeting
events.notes: For board meetings held over more than one day, financial results are disclosed within 30 minutes of the end of the meeting for the day on which they were considered.

events.event: Fraud or defaults - in terms of Para 6 of Clause A of Part A of Schedule III - by the LE, its promoter, director, KMP, senior management or subsidiary; or arrest of KMP, senior management, promoter or director, whether occurring within India or abroad.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Change in directors, KMP (Managing Director, CEO, CFO, Company Secretary etc.), Auditor and Compliance Officer.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Resignation of the auditor - detailed reasons as given by the said auditor.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive
events.disclosureTimelineText: As soon as possible, but not later than 24 hours of receipt of such reasons from the auditor

events.event: Resolution plan / restructuring in relation to loans/borrowings from banks/financial institutions, including: (i) decision to initiate resolution; (ii) signing of ICA by lenders; (iii) finalisation of the Resolution Plan; (iv) implementation of the Resolution Plan; (v) salient features (not involving commercial secrets) of the resolution/restructuring plan as decided by lenders.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: One-time settlement with a bank.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Winding-up petition filed by any party / creditors.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Proceedings of Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings of the listed entity.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: CIRP events of a listed corporate debtor under the Insolvency Code - items (a) to (l), mirroring Part A Para A item 16 (filing of application by corporate applicant / financial creditors; admission, rejection or withdrawal; public announcement u/s 13; list of creditors; appointment/replacement of RP; CoC meeting intimations; invitation of resolution plans; number of plans received; filing with the Tribunal; approval or rejection; specific features and details of the approved plan).
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Intimation related to any change in terms of issue or redemption, or exercising of call / put options.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Intimation related to any change in covenants, or BREACH OF COVENANTS, under the terms of NCDs and/or NCRPS.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Intimation related to forfeiture of unclaimed interest or dividend or principal amount.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive
events.notes: Read with Reg 61A(1) - the LE shall NOT forfeit unclaimed interest/dividend/redemption amount.

events.event: Intimation related to any change in the Debenture Trustee, Credit Rating Agency, or Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive
events.notes: RTA nomenclature substituted by 6th Amdt 2025 w.e.f. 16.12.2025.

events.event: Intimation of comfort / guarantee or any credit enhancement provided by the listed entity to a third party.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.event: Any other information or change that: (a) shall affect the rights and obligations of the holders of non-convertible securities; AND (b) is not in the public domain but is necessary to enable the holders to comprehend the true position and to avoid the creation of a false market in such listed securities.
events.materialityTest: Price sensitive

events.materialityTest: Material / price sensitive

events.event: Change in: (a) board of directors by death, resignation, removal or otherwise; (b) managing director; (c) auditors appointed to audit the books and accounts; (d) the compliance officer; (e) the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, domestic depository or the overseas custodian bank.
events.materialityTest: Material / price sensitive

events.materialityTest: Material / price sensitive

events.event: Short particulars of any other alterations of capital, including calls.
events.materialityTest: Material / price sensitive

events.materialityTest: Material / price sensitive

events.materialityTest: Bearing on performance / price sensitive
